sn47.40:1.1: satipaṭṭhānañca vo bhikkhave, desissāmi satipaṭṭhānabhāvanañca satipaṭṭhānabhāvanāgāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
sn47.40:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.40:1.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.40:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu samudayadhammānupassī kāyasmiṃ viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. vayadhammānupassī kāyasmiṃ viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. samudayavayadhammānupassī kāyasmiṃ viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.40:2.3: samudayadhammānupassī vedanāsu viharati -pe- samudayavayadhammānupassī vedanāsu viharati -pe-
sn47.40:2.4: samudayadhammānupassī cittasmiṃ viharati -pe- vayadhammānupassī cittasmiṃ viharati -pe- samudayavayadhammānupassī cittasmiṃ viharati -pe-
sn47.40:2.5: samudayadhammānupassī dhammesu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. vayadhammānupassī dhammesu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. samudayavayadhammānupassī dhammesu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
